- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.17) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast peak by 2–5%.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.28), model often underestimates; adjust downward by 1–3% to avoid missing downside.
- Model frequently overshoots after recent price spikes (e.g., +5%+ above 75–80); cap forecast at 10–15% above recent high.
- If sentiment is volatile or mixed (±0.10–0.17), model shows mean-reversion bias; smooth forecast toward recent 7–14 day average.
- For 30-day horizon, model often overreacts to short-term sentiment shifts; dampen forecast sensitivity to sentiment > 0.10.
- If true outcome is below 75, model often overpredicts; apply downward bias of 3–6% if sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.
- If true outcome is above 80, model often underpredicts; apply upward bias of 2–5% if sentiment is positive or volatile.
